message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a St. Brigid's cross made of rushes. The likely classification is a plaited article of vegetable plaiting materials, heading 4602, or alternatively a religious article under 4420 or 6913.

Heading 4602 covers basketwork, wickerwork and other articles made directly to shape from plaiting materials. Rush is a vegetable plaiting material, so articles woven from it fall here. Subheading 4602.19 covers other vegetable-material articles, and the statistical suffix for other products is 4602.19.6000 (earlier 4602.19.60). The cross is a woven rush article, not a wood article, so 4420 does not apply.

The HTS under 4602.19 is split as follows:
- 4602.19.05 – Mats and matting
- 4602.19.10 – Articles of the type used for... (other)
- 4602.19.20 – Bags
- 4602.19.30 – Other
- 4602.19.35 – ...
- 4602.19.60 – Other

I am not certain of the exact suffix, so 4602.19.6000 is my best guess. Because the item is a decorative wall hanging, I considered the possibility that it falls under 4602.19.9000 in the 2022 revision. The older number 4602.19.60 had the further breakdown 4602.19.6000 (Other), which I am going with.

